# Non-canonical on purpose (comments, blank lines, parameters out of order): parse must accept it and
# give the same AST as hebrew.seshat. It is the draft reviewed 2026-10-19.
# Hebrew (Dershowitz & Reingold), Seshat text, first draft for review (docs/SESHAT-v0.md §2.8, §4.1)
# Day 0 is 1970-01-01. Year index k is year k + 1 AM.
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
SESHAT:1
NAME:Hebrew
FORMAT:default={month\:day} {month\:name} {year}

BEGIN:VGEAR
UID:leap
POSITIONS:ON=year;PERIOD=19;AT=0,3,6,8,11,14,17;OFFSET=-1
END:VGEAR

BEGIN:VUNIT
UID:year
# year index k is year k + 1 AM
NUMBER:1
# the molad: 29 d 12 h 793 p, read at months elapsed floor((235(k + 1) - 234) / 19)
CROSSING:765433/25920@D-2092590+1007/2160;INDEX=235/1/19
BEGIN:VSTAGE
# lo ADU rosh
RESIDUE:7;ADD=1;IN=2,4,6;OFFSET=-2092590
END:VSTAGE
BEGIN:VSTAGE
# length correction: reads stage 1 one year either side
LENGTH:AT=0;IS=356;ADD=2
LENGTH:AT=-1;IS=382;ADD=1
END:VSTAGE
END:VUNIT

BEGIN:VUNIT
UID:month
IN:year
SLOT:Tishri=30
BEGIN:VSLOT
NAME:Heshvan
LENGTH:SLACK;MIN=29;MAX=30;FILL=2
END:VSLOT
BEGIN:VSLOT
NAME:Kislev
LENGTH:SLACK;MIN=29;MAX=30;FILL=1
END:VSLOT
SLOT:Tevet=29
SLOT:Shevat=30
BEGIN:VSLOT
NAME:Adar I
LENGTH:0
GEAR:leap*30
END:VSLOT
SLOT:Adar=29
SLOT:Nisan=30
SLOT:Iyar=29
SLOT:Sivan=30
SLOT:Tamuz=29
SLOT:Av=30
SLOT:Elul=29
END:VUNIT

END:VCALENDAR
